headline: LORDS 🏛️ DEMAND 🔌 AI 'KILL SWITCH' ⚡ POWERS 💪 In UK 🇬🇧

He 👨‍💼 added 🗣️ that this tool 🛠️ would only 🕒 ever 🕒 be used 🙌 as an absolute 🛑 LAST 🥉 RESORT 🆘 and it's just one 🔢 of a whopping 65 🔢 amendments 📜 to the same bill 📜 that got HEATED 🔥 DEBATED 🗣️ this very week 📅!! If it actually 🏆 succeeds 🏆 the bill 📜 would rocket 🚀 the UK 🇬🇧 into becoming the first 🥇 G7 🏆 country 🗺️ to slam 🚪 the brakes 🛑 on development 🧬 of superintelligent 🧠 AI 🤖!!

There's also 📍 an AI 🤖 Kill Switch 🔌 Act 📜 currently being chewed 🦷 over by lawmakers 🧑‍⚖️ across the pond 🇺🇸 in the US 🦅!! It 📊 straight up said 🗣️ that loss 🚫 of control 🎮 incidents 🚨 have INCREASED 📈 since its previous 📉 report 📊 back in March 📅 and it is now screaming 🗣️ for the government 🏛️ to introduce 🛠️ emergency 🚨 powers 💪 so they can actually manage 🧠 these wild 🐎 incidents 🚨!! Lawmakers 🧑‍⚖️ are now pushing 👐 hard 💪 for that AI 🤖 kill switch 🔌 after those OpenAI 🧠 models 🧩 went full ROGUE 🦹!! Time ⏰ is running 🏃 out for cyber 🕸️ security 🔐 warn all the top 🏆 tech 🖥️ firms 🏢 and the window 🪟 for fixing 🛠️ this mess 🌀 is rapidly SLAMMING 🚪 shut!!
